spans.s:
m. (-कः)
A bird, said to be a sort of crow.
E.
णश to destroy, affix आक.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Destroying.
E.
णश to destroy, affix तृच् with इट् augment, else with a nasal augment नष्टृ.

mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्)
Perishing, decaying, wasting, being destroyed.
E.
नश to perish, and शतृ aff.

f. (-का)
A female bearing a dead child.
E.
नश्यत्, प्रसूतिका a mother.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Mischievous, destructive.
E.
णशि to destroy, affix क्वरप्.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Lost, destroyed, removed, annihilated.
E.
णश to perish, affix क्त.

m. (-न्द्रः)
The moon on the fourth lunation of either half of Bhādra.
E.
नष्ट, and चन्द्र the moon: it is very unlucky to see the moon on these days.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fainted, insensible.
E.
नष्ट, and चेतन conscious.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Insensible, inert.
E.
नष्ट, and चेष्टा effort.

f. (-ता)
Fainting, swooning, insensibility, proceeding either from joy or sorrow, &c.
E.
नष्ट lost, चेष्टता effort.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Unmindful, forgetful.
E.
नष्ट, and संस्मृति recollection.

m. (-ग्निः)
A Brahman or householder who has lost his consecrated fire.
E.
नष्ट lost, and अग्नि fire.

n. (-त्रं)
Booty, plunder.
E.
नष्ट lost, आप्ति gain, and सूत्र thread or chain.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Reduced, become poor.
E.
नष्ट, and अर्थ wealth.

f. (-ला)
The day of new moon when it rises invisible.
E.
नष्ट, and इन्दुकला a digit.

f. (-नाः)
The nose.
E.
नस to sound, affix क्विप्.

f. (-सा)
The nose: see नासा and नासिका.

m. (-शः)
1 Annihilation, loss, destruction, disappearance.
2

Death.
3

Flight, retreat.
4 Abandonment, desertion.
5 (In Arithmetic,) Elimination.
E.
णश to cease to be, affix धञ्.

f. (-सा)
1 The nose.
2 The upper timber of a door.
E.
णस to sound, to stand, अच् aff.

m. (-स्तः)
The nose.
n. (-स्तं)
A sternutatory, snuff, &c.
f. (-स्ता)
A hole bored in the septum of the nose.
E.
णस to make crooked, affix क्त.

m. (-तः)
An ox or any other draft animal, with a string through his nose, the sort of rein usually employed in India.
E.
नस्त as above, the nose, formed into a nominal verb, and क्त added, nozzled or nose-led.

m. (-तः)
An ox led by a string through his nose: see the last; also नस्योत.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Nasal, relating or belonging to the nose.
n. (-स्यं)
A sternutatory, snuff.
f. (-स्या)
The nose.
E.
नसा the nose, यत् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
The rein of an ox passed through the septum of the nostrils.
E.
नासा the nose, यञ् aff.

m. (-तः)
An ox or other animal led by a string through the septum of the nose.
E.
नसा the nose, यत् affix of relation or fitness, and ऊत woven: see नस्तित.

n. (-नं)
Destruction, perishing.
E.
णश to perish, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Destroying, annihilating.
E.
णश to perish, causal form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Destroyed.
E.
नश to perish, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
1 Destructive, destroying, a destroyer.
2 Perishing, being lost or destroyed.
E.
नश to cease to be, in the causal form, affix इनि; or नाश, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging or relating to any thing lost.
m. (-कः)
The owner of any thing lost.
E.
नष्ट, and ठक् aff.

m. du. (-त्यौ)
The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga.
f. (-त्या)
The constellation AŚVINĪ.
E.
न not, असत्य impure.

f. (-न्नी)
A sort of bird; also पूर्णिका.
E.
नासा the nose, छिन्न cut, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-र्त्तः)
Wearing the nose-ring in the right nostril by women who have money and children.
E.
नासा the nose, दक्षिण the right, and आवर्त्त a turning.

m. (-रुः)
The upper timber of a door: see नासा.

m. (-हः)
Thickening of the membrane of the nose, stoppage of the nostrils.
E.
नासा, and नाह binding.

n. (-वः)
Running at the nose.
E.
नासा, and परिस्राव flow.

n. (-न्ध्रं)
The nostril.
E.
नासा, and रन्ध्र a hole.

m. (-लुः)
A plant, commonly Kāyaphal: see कट्फल.
E.
नासा the nose, and लु to cut, affix डु.

m. (-शः)
The bridge of the nose.
E.
नासा, and वंश bambu.

m. (-र्त्तः)
Wearing the nose-ring in the left nostril, a mark of sorrow or distress.
E.
नासा the nose, वाम the left side, आवर्त्त a turning.

m. (-षः)
Dryness of the nostrils.
E.
नासा, and शोष drying.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Blowing or breathing through the nose, snoring, &c.
E.
नासिका the nose, ध्मा to blow, &c. affix खश्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Drinking through the nose.
E.
नासिका, and धेट् to drink, affix खञ्.

f. (-का)
1 The nose.
2 The upper timber, or nose as it were, of a door.
3 A name of the nymph Aśvinī.
E.
नासा as above, affix कन्, fem. form.

n. (-ग्रं)
The tip of the nose.
E.
नासिका, and अग्र end.

n. (-लं)
The mucus of the nose, snot.
E.
नासिका, and मल excrement; it may also be नासमल.

m. du. (-क्यौ)
The two sons of Aśvinī.
n. (-क्यं)
The nose.
E.
नासिका, and यत् affix of identity or descent.

n. (-कं)
The nose.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-रं)
Advancing or skirmishing in front of an army, leaving the line, and defying the enemy by shouts and gestures.
m. (-रः)
The van, or a champion who advances before the line.
E.
णास to sound, affix ईरन्.

ind.
Nonexistence, not so, it is not.
E.
न negative, and अस्ति is, third person singular present tense of अस to be.

m. (-कः)
An atheist, but applied by the orthodox Hindūs, to any one who denies the divine authority of the Vedas, or doubts the legends of the Purāṇas.
E.
नास्ति there is not (a god, &c.) and ठक् aff.

f. (-ता)
Atheism, denial of the deity, of a future state, of the divinity of the Vedas; Bauddhism, heresy, &c.
E.
तल् abstract affix added to the preceding; also with त्व, नास्तिकत्व, or with यत् affix नास्तिक्य.

n. (-क्यं)
Infidelity, atheism.
E.
नास्तिक, and यत् aff.

m. (-दः)
The mango tree.

n. (-त्वं)
Nonexistence.
E.
त्व added to नास्ति; also with तल् affix नास्तिता.
